e.body:
**Strengthening Incentives for Flood Risk Reduction in Catastrophe Modeling and Insurance**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.20820504`）**是一份**由**加州保险厅**委托的**洪灾**风险**建模**与**保险**报告****——**逐字标题为**「**STRENGTHENING INCENTIVES FOR FLOOD RISK REDUCTION IN CATASTROPHE MODELING AND INSURANCE: Recommendations for California Coastal Counties**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**研究工件面**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-12 Zenodo 记录接口实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**是**监管**机构**委托**，**而**不**是**自发**研究**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**记录**逐字**写**「**This report was developed for the California Department of Insurance to assess the state of the science of flood risk modeling and mitigation in California coastal counties and to identify opportunities for advancing the science and integrating mitigation into flood models.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 RIAA **最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**监管**方**提出**的**问题**」**与**「**研究者**自己**想**做**的**问题**」**往往**不同**——**⭐ 前者**通常**更**贴近**「**可**执行**的**规则**与**激励**」**，**故**这类**报告**是**理解**「**监管**在**想**什么**」**的**近路**；**⭐ 对**写**政策**或**监管**方向**作业**的人**，**先**找**「**受**委托**的**报告**」**通常**比**找**综述**论文**更**省**时间**。
**⭐⭐ ② 方法**里**把**访谈**对象**与**家数**写**进**描述**，**这**让**结论**覆盖面**可**判断****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**记录**逐字**列出**三个**来源**（**逐字**：**1) a literature review on food risk modeling; 2) semi-structured interviews with ten flood catastrophe modeling groups, two insurers, and a consumer group; and 3) a multi-sectoral workshop in May, 2026, that convened academic food modelers, private sector food modelers, a set of relevant state decision-makers, reinsurance and insurance sector representatives, nongovernmental organizations, and floodplain managers.**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**：**⭐ 即**「**访谈了**谁、**几家、**还**开**了**什么**会」**是**判断**定性**研究**可信度**的**第一**信息**——**⭐ 而**十家**洪灾**巨灾**建模**机构**在**巨灾**建模**这种**高度**集中**的**行业里**是**相当**高的**比例**（**⭐ 本词条**只**记**家数**，**不**主张**其**是否**覆盖**全部**重要**机构**）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**访谈**类**研究**时**，**在**摘要**里**就**写**清**对象**与**样本量**，**能**省**掉**读者**大量**疑问**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 三份**分层**文件**同时**服务**政策**与**技术**读者****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**文件**逐字**为 **`01_CA-OST_FloodRiskReduction_Report.pdf`（**4,386 KB）**、**`02_CA_OST_FloodRiskReduction_Brief.pdf`（**2,667 KB）** 与 **`03_CA-OST_FloodRiskReduction_Appendix.pdf`（**647 KB）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**：**⭐ 即**「**报告**＋**简报**＋**附录**」**是**一种**值得**照抄**的**交付**结构**——**⭐ 决策者**看**简报**、**分析师**看**报告**、**复核者**看**附录**，**同**一份**研究**不**必**为**三种**读者**写**三**遍**。
**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 元数据**笔误**如实**记录****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**共**四**处**把 **`flood`** 写**成 **`food`****（**⭐ 逐字**为 **`the state of the science of food risk modeling`**、**`a literature review on food risk modeling`**、**`academic food modelers`** 与 **`private sector food modelers`）**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**元数据**笔误**」**是**一条**可**核对**的**事实**（**本条**据**标题**与**上下文**按 **flood** 理解**，**并**照**原文**保留**笔误**）**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**引用**二手**元数据**时**要**用**标题**与**上下文**交叉**验证**，**而**不**要**静默**修正**，**因为**读者**可能**在**别的**地方**看到**同一**笔误**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 窗口**与**可引用性****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**发布日 **2026-09-09****（**窗口内）**、**类型逐字 **`publication`****、**许可逐字 **`cc-by-4.0`****（**可**署名**再**分发**）**、**作者逐字 **`Corringham, Tom` 与 **`Pinto, Denali`****、**DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.20820504`****（**⭐ 同**标题**另有**一条 **`10.5281/zenodo.20820503`** 记录，**本次**取 **`10.5281/zenodo.20820504`**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**许可**允许**再**分发**」**与**「**内容**正确**」**是**两件事**——**⭐ 本词条**未**读**其**内容**，**故**不**评价**其**结论**；**⭐ 记录**另**逐字**写明 **A Technical Steering Committee** 监督**了**过程**（**⭐ 逐字**：**A Technical Steering Committee oversaw this process by providing direction in scoping the initial literature review, workshop agenda, and reviewing drafts of this report.**）**，**并**逐字**声明**结论**为**作者**独立**发现**、**不**必然**代表 **California Department of Insurance** 或 **California Ocean Science Trust** 的**观点**或**背书**（**⭐ 逐字**：**The recommendations in this report reflect the independent findings of the report authors and do not necessarily reflect the views or endorsements of the California Department of Insurance or the California Ocean Science Trust.**）**——**⭐ 即**「**受**委托**」**与**「**被**背书**」**是**两件事**，**引用**时**不**要**把**报告**读**成**监管**立场**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[floodwise]] 覆盖**洪水**风险**信息**、**[[idf-open-model-library]] 覆盖**法国**洪水**模型**库**、**[[catmodeling]] 覆盖**巨灾**建模**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**由**监管**方**委托**、**并**把**减灾**激励**与**建模**科学**现状**放在**一起**讨论**的**报告**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **优先**找**受**监管**委托**的**报告**；**② **方法**里**写清**访谈**对象**与**家数**；**③ **产出**分**报告／**简报／**附录**三层**；**④ **元数据**笔误**要**照**原文**保留**并**标注**；**⑤ **许可**允许**再**分发**不**等于**内容**正确**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**其**任何 **PDF**（**未读**报告、**简报**或**附录**的**内容**）**，**故**不主张**其**结论**、**不主张**其**方法**的**完整性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**Zenodo 记录接口返回的**元数据**（**标题、**描述、**类型、**许可、**作者、**文件**名与**字节数**与 **DOI）**，**未读**其**文件**内容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**加州**保险厅**的**委托**关系**是否**有**正式**文件**（**⭐ 本词条**只**按**其**自述**记录**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**访谈**样本**是否**覆盖**了**行业**主要**机构**（**⭐ 本词条**只**记**家数**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**结论**是否**已**被**任何**监管**规则**采纳**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-12 所见**；**⚠️ 该报告**是**研究**与**政策**材料**，**不**构成**承保**或**合规意见**。

e.summary_en: This is a report commissioned by a state insurance regulator on strengthening incentives for flood risk reduction in catastrophe modelling and insurance, whose title concerns recommendations for coastal counties. **Measured this round**: released on the ninth of September inside the window, typed as a publication, licensed for attribution use, credited to two named authors, and shipped as three documents, namely a main report of about four megabytes, a brief, and an appendix. **This entry belongs to the round theme of research artefact surfaces and fills one of the thinnest categories on the site, academic research, which held about two dozen entries before this round.** **Four things are worth reading: it is commissioned by a regulator rather than self-initiated, stating in writing that it was developed for the state department of insurance, which means it answers questions the regulator posed, namely what the state of the science in flood risk modelling is and how mitigation can be integrated into models, so its conclusions tend to arrive in a policy-usable shape; the method states three sources in writing, namely a literature review, semi-structured interviews with ten flood catastrophe modelling groups, two insurers, and a consumer group, and a multi-sectoral workshop held in May, and putting who was interviewed, how many, and what workshop was convened into the description lets a reader judge how far the conclusions reach, since ten modelling groups is a substantial share in an industry as concentrated as catastrophe modelling; the output is three layered documents serving policy readers and technical readers at once; and the metadata contains an evident typo, writing food for flood in four places, twice in the phrase food risk modelling and twice in the phrase food modelers, which this entry notes while reading the sense as intended, since a metadata typo is itself a checkable fact rather than something to silently correct; and the record states in writing that its recommendations are the independent findings of the authors and do not necessarily reflect the views or endorsements of the state department of insurance or of the ocean science trust, which shows that being commissioned is not the same as being endorsed.** **No document was downloaded this round.**
e.summary_hk: **Strengthening Incentives for Flood Risk Reduction in Catastrophe Modeling and Insurance**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.20820504`）**是一份**由**加州保險廳**委託的**洪災風險建模與保險**報告****——**逐字標題為**「**STRENGTHENING INCENTIVES FOR FLOOD RISK REDUCTION IN CATASTROPHE MODELING AND INSURANCE: Recommendations for California Coastal Counties**」**。**本次實測**：**⭐ 發布日 2026-09-09（**窗口內**）**、**類型逐字 `publication`**、**許可逐字 `cc-by-4.0`**、**作者逐字 `Corringham, Tom` 與 `Pinto, Denali`**；**⭐ 文件逐字三份 PDF（**報告 4,386 KB、**簡報 2,667 KB、**附錄 647 KB**）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**研究工件面**」**，**並補上本站最薄的一欄之一**——**學術研究**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **它是監管機構委託而非自發研究****（**逐字 developed for the California Department of Insurance**）**；**② **方法逐字寫明三個來源****（**逐字**：**文獻綜述；**對十家洪災巨災建模機構、**兩家保險公司與**一個消費者團體的半結構化訪談；**以及 2026 年 5 月一場跨部門工作坊**）**——**⭐ 即**把訪談對象、**家數與**開過什麼會寫進描述**，**讀者就能判斷結論覆蓋面**；**③ **三份分層文件**（**報告、**簡報與**附錄**）**；**④ ⚠️ **元資料有明顯筆誤****（**逐字共四處把 flood 寫成 food**：**兩處 food risk modeling 與**兩處 food modelers**）**——**本條如實指出並按原義理解**；**⭐ ⑤ 報告逐字聲明結論為作者獨立發現**，**不必然代表加州保險廳或加州海洋科學信託的觀點或背書**（**逐字 do not necessarily reflect the views or endorsements of the California Department of Insurance or the California Ocean Science Trust**）**——**⭐ 即**受委託不等於被背書**。**⚠️ 本次**未下載**其任何 PDF**。

This is a report commissioned by a state insurance regulator on strengthening incentives for flood risk reduction in catastrophe modelling and insurance. **This entry belongs to the round theme of research artefact surfaces.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-12 from the record interface**:
**First, it is commissioned by a regulator rather than self-initiated.** The record states that the report was developed for the state department of insurance to assess the state of the science of flood risk modelling and mitigation in coastal counties and to identify opportunities for advancing the science and integrating mitigation into flood models. **Questions posed by a regulator differ from questions a researcher chooses, and the former usually sit closer to executable rules and incentives, which makes commissioned reports a shortcut to understanding what a regulator is thinking, so for policy or regulatory coursework it is usually faster to start from commissioned reports than from review papers.**
**Second, the method names who was interviewed and how many, which lets a reader judge how far the conclusions reach.** The record lists a literature review, semi-structured interviews with ten flood catastrophe modelling groups, two insurers, and a consumer group, and a multi-sectoral workshop held in May that convened academic and private-sector modellers, state decision-makers, reinsurance and insurance representatives, non-governmental organisations, and floodplain managers. **Who was interviewed and how many is the first thing to look for in judging qualitative work, and ten modelling groups is a substantial share in an industry as concentrated as catastrophe modelling, though this entry records only the count and makes no claim about whether every major firm was covered.**
**Third, three layered documents serve policy readers and technical readers at once.** The files are a main report of about four megabytes, a brief, and an appendix. **A report plus a brief plus an appendix is a delivery structure worth copying, because decision makers read the brief, analysts read the report, and reviewers read the appendix, so one study does not have to be written three times for three audiences.**
**Fourth, a metadata typo is recorded as measured.** The description writes food for flood in four places: twice in the phrase food risk modelling and twice in the phrase food modelers. **A metadata typo is itself a checkable fact, and this entry reads the sense as intended from the title and context while keeping the typo visible rather than silently correcting it, because a reader may meet the same typo elsewhere, and cross-checking second-hand metadata against the title and context is the discipline.**
**Fifth, the window status and citability.** It was published on the ninth of September inside the window, typed as a publication, licensed for attribution redistribution, credited to two named authors, and carries a persistent identifier, with a sibling record of the same title also present. **A licence permitting redistribution and the content being correct are two different things, and this entry has not read the content, so it does not assess the conclusions. The record also states in writing that a technical steering committee oversaw the process by providing direction in scoping the initial literature review, the workshop agenda, and the review of drafts, and that the recommendations reflect the independent findings of the authors and do not necessarily reflect the views or endorsements of the state department of insurance or of the ocean science trust. Being commissioned and being endorsed are therefore two different things, and the report should not be read as a regulatory position.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover flood risk information, a French flood model library, and catastrophe modelling, **while this entry supplies the form of a regulator-commissioned report that discusses mitigation incentives together with the state of modelling science. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: prefer reports commissioned by a regulator; state who was interviewed and how many; deliver report, brief, and appendix as layers; keep metadata typos visible rather than silently correcting them; and remember that a redistributable licence does not make content correct.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no document was downloaded**, none of the report, brief, or appendix was read, **so no claim is made about its conclusions or the completeness of its method**. **Second, only metadata returned by the record interface was read**, not the file contents. **Third, whether its commissioning relationship with the department is documented formally was not verified**, this entry recording only what the record says. **Fourth, whether its interview sample covered the main firms in the industry was not verified**, only the count being recorded. **Fifth, whether its conclusions have been adopted in any regulatory rule was not verified. Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-12 and states plainly that the report is research and policy material rather than an underwriting or compliance opinion.**

**Strengthening Incentives for Flood Risk Reduction in Catastrophe Modeling and Insurance**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.20820504`）**是一份**由**加州保險廳**委託的**洪災風險建模與保險**報告****——**逐字標題為**「**STRENGTHENING INCENTIVES FOR FLOOD RISK REDUCTION IN CATASTROPHE MODELING AND INSURANCE: Recommendations for California Coastal Counties**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**研究工件面**」**。
**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-12 Zenodo 記錄介面實測）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 監管機構委託而非自發研究****——**逐字**This report was developed for the California Department of Insurance to assess the state of the science of flood risk modeling and mitigation in California coastal counties and to identify opportunities for advancing the science and integrating mitigation into flood models.**；**⭐ 即**受委託報告通常更貼近可執行的規則與激勵**。
**⭐⭐ ② 方法寫明訪談對象與家數****——**逐字**1) a literature review on food risk modeling; 2) semi-structured interviews with ten flood catastrophe modeling groups, two insurers, and **1) a literature review on food risk modeling; 2) semi-structured interviews with ten flood catastrophe modeling groups, two insurers, and a consumer group; and 3) a multi-sectoral workshop in May, 2026, that convened academic food modelers, private sector food modelers, a set of relevant state decision-makers, reinsurance and insurance sector representatives, nongovernmental organizations, and floodplain managers.**；**⭐ 即**十家建模機構在高度集中的巨災建模行業裡屬相當高比例**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 三份分層文件****——**逐字**`01_CA-OST_FloodRiskReduction_Report.pdf`（4,386 KB）、`02_CA_OST_FloodRiskReduction_Brief.pdf`（2,667 KB）、`03_CA-OST_FloodRiskReduction_Appendix.pdf`（647 KB）**。
**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 元資料筆誤如實記錄****——****描述共四處把 `flood` 寫成 `food`**（**逐字為 `the state of the science of food risk modeling`、`a literature review on food risk modeling`、`academic food modelers` 與 `private sector food modelers`**）**；**⭐ 即**按標題與上下文理解為 flood**，**並照原文保留筆誤**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 窗口與可引用性****——**發布日 2026-09-09**、**類型 `publication`**、**許可 `cc-by-4.0`**、**作者 Corringham, Tom 與 Pinto, Denali**、**DOI `10.5281/zenodo.20820504`**（**同標題另有 `10.5281/zenodo.20820503` 一條，本次取 10.5281/zenodo.20820504**）**；**⭐ 記錄另逐字寫明 A Technical Steering Committee 監督了過程**，**並逐字聲明結論為作者獨立發現**、**不必然代表 California Department of Insurance 或 California Ocean Science Trust 的觀點或背書**（**逐字 The recommendations in this report reflect the independent findings of the report authors and do not necessarily reflect the views or endorsements of the California Department of Insurance or the California Ocean Science Trust.**）**——**⭐ 即**受委託與被背書是兩件事**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[floodwise]]、[[idf-open-model-library]]、[[catmodeling]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**由監管方委託、**並把減災激勵與建模科學現狀放在一起討論的報告**」**這一形態**。
**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **優先找受監管委託的報告**；**② **方法寫清訪談對象與家數**；**③ **產出分三層**；**④ **元資料筆誤照原文保留**；**⑤ **許可可再分發不等於內容正確**。
**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載**其任何 PDF**，**不主張**其結論與方法完整性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料**，**未讀**其文件內容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**其與加州保險廳的委託關係是否有正式文件**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其訪談樣本是否覆蓋行業主要機構**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其結論是否已被任何監管規則採納**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-12 所見**；**⚠️ 該報告是研究與政策材料**，**不構成**承保或合規意見**。
